cardinality.rule: Events.VIEWPORT_NEW_IMAGE_SET: DISPLAY_SETS_CHANGED also fires when an overlay such as a labelmap is added or removed: a listener that cares only for the source adds if (!evt.detail.sourceChanged) return, and the detail has no imageIds and no currentImageIdIndex (ask the viewport)

Events.VIEWPORT_NEW_IMAGE_SET: DISPLAY_SETS_CHANGED also fires when an overlay such as a labelmap is added or removed: a listener that cares only for the source adds if (!evt.detail.sourceChanged) return, and the detail has no imageIds and no currentImageIdIndex (ask the viewport)
Types.EventTypes.StackViewportNewStackEvent: the detail has displaySets, sourceDisplaySetId, added, removed and sourceChanged, and no imageIds
Types.EventTypes.StackViewportNewStackEventDetail: the detail has displaySets, sourceDisplaySetId, added, removed and sourceChanged, and no imageIds

Events.VIEWPORT_NEW_IMAGE_SET: DISPLAY_SETS_CHANGED also fires when an overlay such as a labelmap is added or removed: a listener that cares only for the source adds if (!evt.detail.sourceChanged) return, and the detail has no imageIds and no currentImageIdIndex (ask the viewport)

Events.VOLUME_VIEWPORT_NEW_VOLUME: DISPLAY_SETS_CHANGED also fires when an overlay such as a labelmap is added or removed: a listener that cares only for the source adds if (!evt.detail.sourceChanged) return, it fires for a stack too, and the detail has no volumeActors (call viewport.getActors())
